mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.unit_name as unitName, u.unit_principal_name as unitPrincipalName, u.unit_principal_phone as unitPrincipalPhone, u.unit_address as unitAddress, u.social_credit_code as socialCreditCode, ctd.name as cylinderTypes FROM contract c LEFT JOIN unit u ON c.unit_id = u.unit_id LEFT JOIN contract_cylinder_line ccl ON ccl.contract_id = c.contract_id LEFT JOIN cylinder_type_dict ctd ON ctd.cylinder_type_id = ccl.cylinder_type_id WHERE c.contract_id = #{contractId}

WITH RECURSIVE renewal_chain AS ( -- 查找根合同（parent_contract_id为NULL或找到最初的父合同） SELECT * FROM contract WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} UNION ALL -- 查找所有子合同 SELECT c.* FROM contract c INNER JOIN renewal_chain rc ON c.parent_contract_id = rc.contract_id ) SELECT * FROM renewal_chain ORDER BY renewal_count ASC
SELECT * FROM contract WHERE contract_status = 5 AND end_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY end_date ASC
